author: ohtadmin
title: Frances Brazil-Kelleher
text:
Frances Brazil-Kelleher, 76, of Jamestown, passed away peacefully Sept. 21, 2025.
She was the beloved wife of the late Jeremiah Kelleher.
Born in South Kingstown, she was the daughter of the late John and Florence (Andrade) Brazil.
Frances was a proud graduate of St. Catherine Academy in Newport and went on to earn her degree in communication arts from Fordham University. She began her career with the North Kingstown Standard Times and later dedicated many years as a devoted property manager at Hillcrest Acres Apartments in Attleboro, Mass., where she was deeply respected and admired.
A woman of faith, Frances was a communicant of St. Mark Catholic Church in Jamestown. She found joy in the simple pleasures of life, especially her walks through the neighborhood, where she greeted everyone with a warm smile and kind conversation. Her thoughtful presence and gentle spirit made her a cherished friend to many.
Frances leaves behind her sister, Jean Della Vecchia ( Louis) of Hope Valley; nephews, Brian Brazil of Warwick and Jared Brazil (Stacy) of Cranston; a niece, Rebecca Brazil of North Kingstown; and a great-niece Gwendolyn Brazil. She also will be missed by many extended relatives, friends and former co-workers.
She was predeceased by her brother, David Brazil.
A visitation will be held from 9-11 a.m. Monday, Sept. 29 in the Fagan-Quinn Funeral Home of Patrick Quinn Funerals and Cremations, 825 Boston Neck Road, North Kingstown.
A funeral home service will begin at 11 a.m. in the funeral home. Burial to follow in St. Mark Cemetery, Jamestown.
In lieu of flowers, donations in Frances’ name can be made to The Alzheimer’s Association of Rhode Island, 245 Waterman St. #306, Providence, RI 02906.
Kindly visit the Fagan-Quinn Funeral Home online for information and condolences, www.PatrickQuinnFuneralsandCremations.com.
